scope: Local validation of the opt-in Swift Package port; separate from the historical research-app iPhone measurements.

macos_release_tests.command: TEST_RUNNER_REUSE_STREAMING_CHECKPOINT=/path/to/verified/realtime-reuse.safetensors xcodebuild test -scheme ReuseApple-Package -configuration Release -destination "platform=macOS,arch=arm64" -derivedDataPath BuildPackage -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath SourcePackages ENABLE_TESTABILITY=YES CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -resultBundlePath Validation/metal-port/package-tests-v2.xcresult
macos_release_tests.command_note: The checkpoint path is sanitized; the run used the verified local checkpoint with the SHA256 above.
macos_release_tests.state_scope: At each depth, four synthetic frames replayed twice across reset; every convolution and recurrent state tensor compared against the standard model on every frame. All recurrent state remains FP32. Candidate waveform reset replay is bit-exact.
macos_release_tests.numeric_tolerance: Per tensor/audio comparison: relative RMS error < 1e-4 OR maximum absolute error < 1e-5. Prepared-frequency kernel comparison and candidate waveform reset replay additionally require exact float bits.
macos_release_tests.default_regression_scope: Existing frozen-reference, compiled, pooled, legacy fallback, framing and reset tests passed without changing their assertions.

ios_release_build.command: xcodebuild build -scheme ReuseApple-Package -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -derivedDataPath BuildIOS -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath SourcePackages -disableAutomaticPackageResolution CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -resultBundlePath Validation/metal-port/package-ios-build.xcresult

source_fingerprints.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted newline-terminated "relative/path sha256(file)" records for all Swift files under the stated folder.

limitations: No physical-iPhone timing or inference was run for this package port.
The package retains its decoder-feature compilation boundary; historical research-app timing does not establish this port's latency.
Synthetic integration tests and numerical equivalence checks do not establish general speech quality or indefinite stream stability.
Only optional timing benchmarks were skipped; checkpoint-backed correctness tests ran.
